en-US.description: A cross-platform desktop AI reading assistant that summarizes selected text with a global hotkey.
en-US.longDescription: ReadBrief is a desktop AI reading assistant for macOS and Windows. Select text in any application and press a global hotkey: a system-level floating window near your cursor streams an AI-generated summary, and every summary is saved to a searchable local history. It supports multiple providers over the OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini protocols with speed testing, keeps API keys in the Rust backend, and offers custom prompts, tags and favorites, light and dark themes, and a bilingual interface.

zh-CN.description: 选中文字、按下快捷键，AI 即刻流式生成要点总结的多平台桌面阅读助手。
zh-CN.longDescription: ReadBrief 是一款支持 macOS 与 Windows 的桌面 AI 阅读助手。在任意应用中选中文字并按下全局快捷键，靠近光标的系统级浮窗即会流式生成 AI 要点总结，总结保存到本地可搜索的历史记录。它支持 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 协议的多服务商配置与测速，API 密钥由 Rust 后端保管，提供自定义提示词、标签收藏、明暗主题与中英双语界面。
zh-CN.name: ReadBrief
